_about: The abandoned Emberpup (src/emberpup_encounter.py). Every run, on one floor from 3 to 8, a small fire lizard sits alone on a rock under a rain cloud, where a hard master left him. He has learned to shy from anyone bigger than he is (Brandon, 2026-11-13; the fire line is a homage, never a copy). Trust is earned: leave him food three times, at least feed_gap_turns apart (leaving his floor counts as waiting), each feed a step warmer; and keep the rain off him with the Bloomleaf Cloak, the one thing that turns it, which Old Nickel the kobold wears (src/emberpup_encounter.py, the 'cloak' block below). Only then does 'I choose you' ask the animal quiz (tier 2, two right answers). Pass and he joins you as your Emberpup, wearing the cloak at every stage of his line. The pup is 'he' throughout (Brandon's word).
name: Emberpup
_attack_karma_note: No single karma loss is bigger than one (Brandon, 2026-10-18; src/karma.py MAX_LOSS).
_first_feed_karma_note: Paid only while the karma gate is OFF. With the gate on (the default) feeding moves no karma (Brandon, decision 9; src/emberpup_encounter.py).
_visits_needed_note: Feeds before he trusts the hero (winning-build plan 3.8: 'leaving him food a few times').
_feed_gap_turns_note: Turns he needs to eat in peace between feeds (plan 3.8b). Leaving his floor counts as waiting. Sooner, and he is still eating: too_soon, and nothing counts.

cloak._doc: The one thing that turns his rain, and who wears it: Old Nickel, on one floor from first_floor to the pup's, drawn once a run with the pup's own generator (src/emberpup_encounter.py, BloomleafMixin).

title: A LONELY EMBERPUP
story: In the middle of the room a small orange fire lizard sits all alone upon a rock. A little grey cloud hangs beneath the ceiling, and from it the rain falls upon him and his rock and upon nothing else, so that his scales are soaked and the flame at the tip of his tail has dwindled to a guttering flicker. You can see that little by little the rain is putting out his fire.

When you take a step nearer he shrinks back trembling against the stone. An old scar runs across his snout, and a frayed cord is knotted round the rock, as though something had once been tied there and left. It is plain that whoever owned him was hard on him and that someone bigger than himself has hurt him before, and he can see that you are bigger than he is.

He was left here on purpose, and no one is coming back for him. Yet here he stays, keeping his little fire alive in the rain though it is nearly out, and as he watches your hands and your boots you can tell that he longs to run from you.
waiting: The Emberpup huddles on his rock in the rain. When you draw near he flinches and makes himself small, as a creature will that has been hurt before by something bigger.
The Emberpup watches you from his rock. He flinches still when you move, yet his eyes have left your boots and follow your hands now.
The Emberpup lifts his head as you come in. This time he does not flinch, and the flame upon his tail flickers a little brighter.
As you come near, the Emberpup creeps to the edge of his rock, as close as the rain will allow, and you see that he is afraid of you no longer.
waiting_sheltered: Your leaf cloak is spread over his rock, and the rain runs off it in beads.

options.shelter: Leave him something against the rain

no_food: You search your pack, but you have nothing he could eat, and the Emberpup watches you warily from his rock.
fed: You set the {food} down at the foot of his rock and step back. The Emberpup darts down to snatch it and carries it to the far side of the stone, where he eats with his back to the wall, watching you carefully all the while, for he is still wary, and still hurt.
You set down the {food} and step back again. He takes the food and scampers away, but this time he lingers for a moment before he eats, and he seems to relax.

This time he does not run. He eats the {food} before your eyes, and when he has finished he edges closer and sniffs very gently at your hand, as a hurt creature does that is learning to trust, and all the while the flame of his tail burns steady and bright.
fed_again: He eats the {food} from your hand, and his flame grows steady. When he looks up at you, you can see that he is ready to listen.
_too_soon_note: Come back before feed_gap_turns have passed: one line per feed so far (Brandon 2026-11-14, the first line his own), the last for any later feed.
too_soon: The Emberpup, still eating the treat you provided, growls and backs away as you approach.
The Emberpup is still eating the treat you left him. He hunches over it and growls softly as you come near, though this time he does not run.
already_fed: He has eaten and his flame is steady, and now he watches you to see what you will do.
refused: You hold out your hand and say it, but the Emberpup cringes against the stone as though you had raised a fist. He does not yet trust you, nor anyone else who is bigger than he is.
refused_trust: He looks from your hand to your face and shrinks away, for once someone bigger than he is spoke kindly to him and afterward hurt him. He needs more time before he can be sure of you.
refused_hungry: He is cold and hungry again, and he will not come down until you have left him something to eat.
refused_cold: He wants to come. But the rain is still on him and his flame is half drowned, so that he will not leave his rock as matters stand. A cloak of leaves would turn this rain.
no_shelter: You have nothing that would keep this rain off him, for cloth soaks through and iron runs wet. A cloak of leaves would turn this rain.
not_leaves: You hold your {item} over his rock, but the rain soaks through and drips on him all the same. A cloak of leaves would turn this rain.
take_off: The leaf cloak is on your own back. Take it off first, and then you can leave it over his rock.
already_sheltered: Your leaf cloak is still over his rock, and now that he is out of the rain his flame burns straight.
sheltered: You spread the {item} over the Emberpup's rock. The rain falls upon the broad leaves and runs off them in beads, so that for the first time in a long while no water touches him, and the flame of his tail grows steady and stands upright. A lizard cannot make his own warmth but must take it from the world, and all this while the rain has been taking it away from him. From this hour the leaves are his.
ignore: You leave the Emberpup on his rock, and he watches you as you go.
attack: As you raise your weapon the Emberpup gives one small cry of fear, as if he had known all along that it would come to this. He scrambles from the rock and flees into the dark with the little rain cloud following after him, and you never see him again.
attack_chronicle: Hurt the fire lizard left in the rain. He fled into the dark.
pass: The Emberpup looks at you for a long moment. You are big and might have hurt him, and in all this time you never did. And so he climbs down from the rock with the leaf cloak still round his shoulders and walks out from under the rain to press his warm side against your leg, while behind him the little cloud thins away to nothing and the flame on his tail blazes up bright and strong.
fail: You try, but the words come out wrong and your voice is too loud, so that the Emberpup flinches and creeps back to the middle of his rock. Yet he has not fled, and when he is warm and fed again he may listen.
name_prompt: Will you give your Emberpup a name?
named_message: {name} the Emberpup will not be left behind again.
unnamed_message: Your Emberpup will not be left behind again.
named_chronicle: Found a little fire lizard left on a rock in the rain by someone who was cruel to him. I named him {name}. He wears the leaf cloak I gave him, he walks right at my heel, and I am never leaving him anywhere.
unnamed_chronicle: Found a little fire lizard left on a rock in the rain by someone who was cruel to him. He wears the leaf cloak I gave him, he walks right at my heel now, and I am never leaving him anywhere.

log.sheltered: You leave your {item} over the Emberpup's rock.
log.fled: The Emberpup flees into the dark.
log.shied: The Emberpup shies away from you.
log.joined: The Emberpup comes down off his rock to you.

pet_wears_cloak: He wears the Bloomleaf Cloak you gave him: rain runs off it, and water and cold do him no extra harm.
evolved_cloaked: The leaf cloak still hangs round his shoulders.
